title: maxi­malism
subtitle: let the visuals be loud, and the design meets them there.

paragraphs: when a palette feels more like a void than a statement, it's time to get back to what moves people: color.
bold color, texture and detail — packed imagery that breaks the rules of "clean design."
permission to be bold. more daring than you think is bold — so much color and type you begin to doubt yourself.
at its core it's curation: within the chaos, a theme is always being represented.
keep a firm grasp of hierarchy and grid. loud visuals still need order to read.
